preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 10.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 10.
The number of levels k must be between 1 and 1000.
The constant w must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(level) == n for level in levels)
preconditions.description: Each level must have exactly n lines.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in row) for row in level) for level in levels)
preconditions.description: Each character in the levels must be either '.' or a letter of the English alphabet.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must be the minimum number of transferred bytes.
The number of pairs in the output must equal the number of levels k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k and (y == 0 or 1 <= y < x) for x, y in pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair (x, y) must have x between 1 and k, and y either 0 or a previously transferred level index less than x.
